scenarios.title: An unearthed creature is exiled at the beginning of the next end step
decisions: A activates unearth on Dregscape Zombie in A's graveyard, paying {B}.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and Dregscape Zombie returns to the battlefield.
The turn continues with no further actions until the beginning of the end step; the delayed trigger, if any, resolves.

variants.label: unearthed
variants.expected: Dregscape Zombie returns to the battlefield and, at the beginning of the end step, is exiled by the delayed trigger. It is in A's exile zone, not the graveyard.

variants.label: reanimated
variants.delta: A casts Zombify (paying {3}{B}) targeting Dregscape Zombie instead of activating unearth.
variants.expected: Dregscape Zombie returns to the battlefield with no delayed trigger and is still on the battlefield after the end step.

scenarios.title: An unearthed creature that would leave the battlefield is exiled instead
decisions: A activates unearth on Dregscape Zombie, paying {B}; the ability resolves and Dregscape Zombie returns to the battlefield.
A passes priority. B casts Shock targeting Dregscape Zombie, tapping Mountain.
Shock resolves and deals 2 damage to Dregscape Zombie (2/1).

variants.label: unearthed
variants.expected: Dregscape Zombie is destroyed by lethal damage but is exiled instead of going to the graveyard. A's graveyard is empty.

variants.label: reanimated
variants.delta: A casts Zombify (paying {3}{B}) targeting Dregscape Zombie instead of activating unearth.
variants.expected: Dregscape Zombie dies normally and moves to A's graveyard. It is not in exile.

scenarios.title: An unearthed creature has haste
decisions: A activates unearth on Dregscape Zombie, paying {B}; the ability resolves and Dregscape Zombie returns to the battlefield.
A moves to combat; at the declare attackers step A considers attacking with Dregscape Zombie.

variants.label: unearthed
variants.expected: Dregscape Zombie is a legal attacker (it has haste).

variants.label: reanimated
variants.delta: A casts Zombify (paying {3}{B}) targeting Dregscape Zombie instead of activating unearth.
variants.expected: Dregscape Zombie came under A's control this turn and has no haste, so it is not a legal attacker.

scenarios.title: Unearth can be activated only as a sorcery and only from the graveyard
decisions: A has priority with an empty stack and considers activating unearth ({B}) on Dregscape Zombie.

variants.label: combat_step
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Unearth can be activated only at sorcery timing, so activating it is not legal (can_play false).

variants.label: card_in_hand
variants.delta: Dregscape Zombie is in A's hand instead of the graveyard.
variants.expected: Unearth functions only while the card is in the graveyard, so activating it is not legal (can_play false).
